description: Port of Ruff's F522 (string-dot-format-extra-named-arguments): a `.format` call without `**` on a valid format string, passing a keyword argument no named field (top level or nested in a spec) reads. `formatArgs` reads the format string receiving `.format` (a str literal with no f/t/b prefix, implicit concatenations joined, escapes decoded, parentheses transparent) with the `braceFormat` grammar (a port of ruff_python_literal's format parser as pyflakes' FormatSummary reads it), and the call's arguments as Ruff's strings.rs does.
